newsitem.title: USA: HF Bancorp names chief executive.
newsitem.headline: HF Bancorp names chief executive.

text.p: HF Bancorp Thursday named Richard Cupp as president and chief executive officer, replacing Robert Eichinger who will remain chairman of the board.
Cupp will also take the president and chief executive positions of the company's principal subsidiary, Hemet Federal Savings and Loan Association.

Cupp previously served as president and CEO at Ventura County National Bancorp, from 1993 until its acquisition by City National Bank earlier this year. He began his banking career in 1963 at First Interstate Bank.
